summary.text: Leon Stavrinakis, listed on Ballotpedia as Leonidas Stavrinakis, is a Democratic attorney who has represented District 119 in the South Carolina House of Representatives since 2006, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Leon Stavrinakis earned a B.A. from the College of Charleston in 1988 and a J.D. from the University of South Carolina School of Law in 1992.
He served as a 9th Circuit assistant solicitor from 1993 to 1996 and has worked as an attorney with Stavrinakis Law Firm since 1996.
Stavrinakis served on the Charleston County Council from 1999 to 2006 and was council chairman from 2005 to 2006.
For 2025-2026 he is assigned to the House Ethics Committee and the Ways and Means Committee.
